description: This file defines the code-behind for the 'AdminLeaderboard' web page in an Online Examination System. It handles page load, navigation button clicks, and search functionality (currently commented out).

classes.name: AdminLeaderboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminLeaderboard page, inheriting from System.Web.UI.Page, managing leaderboard-related actions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. Currently, the database loading logic is commented out.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminPanel.aspx page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminQueue.aspx page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Intended to handle leaderboard button click; currently no implementation.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Sets a session variable with the selected semester; database search code is commented out.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and transfers to the LoginPage.aspx.
